documentation: Requires that this object permit assignment of scripts of this type. May fail for reasons such as the script type not being supported, or secret aspects blocking assignments.
restrictions.name: RequiresAssignableScript

documentation: Guarded APIs only accept unit token pairs that can be compared with one another. For example, comparisons where either unit is 'player' or 'target' are permitted, but comparisons between 'nameplate3' and 'boss1' are not.
restrictions.name: RequiresComparableUnitTokens

documentation: Guarded APIs and events require that callers have access to the identity of a supplied unit token.
restrictions.name: RequiresDeclassifiedUnitIdentity

documentation: Guarded APIs reject access for tainted callers if the object has the secret Text aspect assigned.
restrictions.name: RequiresFontStringTextAccess

documentation: Guarded APIs require that that the requested aura be non-secret at the time of the API call. This does not raise a blocked action error - instead, protected APIs will return no values.
restrictions.name: RequiresNonSecretAura

documentation: Requires a valid script type supported by this object. If not supported, functions will return no values.
restrictions.name: RequiresSupportedScript

documentation: Guarded APIs on a timed signal map raise an error when the map holds secret values and is accessed from a tainted execution context.
restrictions.name: RequiresTimedSignalMapAccess

documentation: Guarded APIs and events require that callers have access to unit aura data.
restrictions.name: RequiresUnitAuraAccess

documentation: Guarded APIs and events require that callers have access to unit identity values. This does not raise a blocked action error - instead, protected APIs will return no values.
restrictions.name: RequiresUnitIdentityAccess

documentation: Restricts sending chat messages on chat types that can be observed by external players. Only applies during instance encounters for messages initiated from macros.
restrictions.name: RestrictedForMacroChatMessages

documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when PvP match addon restrictions are in effect.
restrictions.name: SecretInActivePvPMatch

documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when encounter, challenge mode, or PvP match addon restrictions are in effect, and when the player is on a communication-restricted map such as a dungeon or raid.
restrictions.name: SecretInChatMessagingLockdown

documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when the player is on an addon-restricted map such as a dungeon or raid.
restrictions.name: SecretOnRestrictedMaps

documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when an object has secret anchoring information.
restrictions.name: SecretWhenAnchoringSecret

documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when combat, encounter, challenge mode, or PvP match addon restrictions are in effect.
restrictions.name: SecretWhenAurasRestricted

documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when combat, encounter, challenge mode, or PvP match addon restrictions are in effect. Individual spells may be flagged as never or always secret, which takes priority over restrictions.
restrictions.name: SecretWhenCooldownsRestricted

documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when combat addon restrictions are in effect.
restrictions.name: SecretWhenInCombat

documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values if the subject unit is not the active player, unless they are an active spectator or commentator of a PvP match.
restrictions.name: SecretWhenLossOfControlInfoRestricted

documentation: Guarded APIs produce secret values if the subject Lua table contains any secret keys.
restrictions.name: SecretWhenLuaTableHasSecretKeys

documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when combat, encounter, challenge mode, or PvP match addon restrictions are in effect. Individual totem spell auras may be flagged as never or always secret, which takes priority over restrictions.
restrictions.name: SecretWhenTotemSlotSecret

documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when combat, encounter, challenge mode, or PvP match addon restrictions are in effect. Individual spells may be flagged as never or always secret, which takes priority over restrictions.
restrictions.name: SecretWhenUnitAuraRestricted

documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values based upon supplied unit tokens. Comparisons involving compound unit tokens (eg. 'boss1target') are always secret. This restriction only applies when the player is on an addon-restricted map.
restrictions.name: SecretWhenUnitComparisonRestricted

documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when the unit isn't player-controlled.
restrictions.name: SecretWhenUnitHealthMaxRestricted

documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when the unit isn't player-controlled or in the party/raid. For compound tokens (eg. 'boss1target'), results are secret if any unit in the chain fails this.
restrictions.name: SecretWhenUnitIdentityRestricted

documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values under regular unit identity secrecy rules, except in PvP when the queried unit is a player.
restrictions.name: SecretWhenUnitNameIdentityRestricted

documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values based on aura secrecy, except for unit tokens under the player's direct control.
restrictions.name: SecretWhenUnitPossessionRestricted

documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when the unit isn't player-controlled. Individual power types may be flagged as never or always secret, which takes priority.
restrictions.name: SecretWhenUnitPowerMaxRestricted

documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values for power types not explicitly flagged as being never secret, unless the subject unit does not have a power of this type.
restrictions.name: SecretWhenUnitPowerRestricted

documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values if the unit being queried for cast information is not the player or their pet. Individual spells may be flagged as never or always secret, which takes priority.
restrictions.name: SecretWhenUnitSpellCastRestricted

documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when access to unit stats would generally produce secret values.
restrictions.name: SecretWhenUnitStatsRestricted

documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values based upon supplied unit tokens. Queries where only one unit token is specified, or where one unit token is the player, their pet, or an ally while the other is a nameplate, boss, target, etc., are generally not secret.
restrictions.name: SecretWhenUnitThreatStateRestricted

documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values based upon supplied unit tokens. Queries where only one unit token is specified, or where one unit token is the player, their pet, or an ally while the other is a non-boss or nameplate target, are generally not secret.
restrictions.name: SecretWhenUnitThreatValuesRestricted

documentation: Guarded APIs require that the nameplate frame must allow changes to its hit test points.
restrictions.name: RequiresCanChangeHitTestPoints

documentation: Requires that all mouse foci are not forbidden, hidden from the global environment, fully locked down, script inaccessible, or protected frames (while in combat)
restrictions.name: MouseFocusValidForLimitedInput

documentation: Prevents Remove and Null transliterators when used with secret text arguments.
restrictions.name: TransliteratorAllowed
